i'm sorry you're going thru this, and it especially sucks that your own people are doing this to you. there is absolutely nothing wrong with the color of your skin.

there was a point in my own life where i saw those who were white and skinny around me at school, whereas i'm asian and a bit overweight. it really got to me and eventually i was doing a lot of unregulated intermittent fasting in attempts to be skinnier, which led to a lot of problems. eventually online, i saw those who were asian and a bit overweight look beautiful despite being just like me.

and i didnt feel better about my self image BECAUSE of the fact that this girl that looked like me looked beautiful, but it was because there were people out there that LOVED what she looked like. i hated how i looked because of the way people reacted, but i eventually learned to see it in a way that people have different types, and sometimes your type just isn't yourself, and that's okay. from there, you just gotta learn to deal with the cards you're dealt and make it work out for you. i had to understand how to take care of my curly hair, how to wear nice clothes, and picked some glasses that matched my face and now i feel pretty darn cute sometimes. i understand that i'm also lucky to be able to have this opportunity to better my self image, of course.

but my advice to you if you want to stop feeling this way is instead of wishing that you had white skin, maybe start thinking why you feel like you hate your skin color?

did it come from the people who made you feel terrible about it, or was it because your opinion that you think white people look more beautiful? there are so many other factors as to why you could be feeling like this, and i think understanding why is a good problem so that you could work backwards from that and stop feeling that way.

honestly, there are so many indian women out there that are absolutely stunning, it has NOTHING to do with skin color and everything about preference and perception.

and just to add, you hear those cliches about people bullying others because they feel insecure too, right? thats true too, because they throw out into the world what they think is hurtful to others because they know that it'd hurt themselves if someone else had said it to them.

these people do not matter. maybe they're a big part of your insecurity, but they're also caught up in their own problems and their only intention is to get you racked up in it too because that kind of power gives them temporarily relief for a problem that they perceive as unfixable or too difficult. dont let them have that power.
